name: Katsuragi Yuuya
source:
The protagonist of this work. He lives with his father and mother. His father is busy with work and does not come home often,
but he has no inconvenience and lives an ordinary life.

He is a good-looking young man with a little bit of a bad-boy attitude. He is popular with girls in his own way, but he has never had any experience with women because he is a pure hearted person.

Ever since he found out about an affair between his mother and his best friend, he has been swirling with black emotions.
